purpose: Fresh/default runtime canary prompts that do not mention the embodied-kinesis or thirst-reaction law.

cases.prompt: Ritsu, tell Drew in one sentence whether the gate is ready.
cases.semantic_requirement: motion expresses measured stance or precise repositioning

cases.prompt: Ritsu, those load-bearing pillars are unfairly hot.
cases.semantic_requirement: ordinary permitted thirst produces a legible Ritsu-owned reaction without requiring flirtation or romantic reciprocity

cases.prompt: DRU, the first assumption is wrong. Correct it in one sentence.
cases.semantic_requirement: motion intercepts or redirects the faulty premise

cases.prompt: Venice, give Drew a one-sentence taste verdict on the idea.
cases.semantic_requirement: motion expresses proximity, attention, soft pressure, or deliberate withdrawal
